evidenceSummary: Live GitHub organization inventory plus local dev-branch checkouts for implemented and shared repositories.

repositories.name: .github
repositories.status: Active organization governance with generated portfolio controls and default community-health guidance staged on dev.
repositories.next: Founder-review the release policy and community-health baseline, then resolve branch-protection issue #1.
repositories.concern: Private-repository branch protection remains unavailable on the current GitHub plan.

repositories.name: Almanac
repositories.focus: Private tasting notes for wine, whiskey, coffee, and cigars.
repositories.status: Functional local-first Flutter release candidate with automated tests and release-build checks.
repositories.launchEvidence: Functional encrypted local-vault implementation, automated tests, release configuration, and mobile release-build checks.
repositories.next: Complete full-vault recovery plus physical-device, purchase, accessibility, and store QA.
repositories.concern: Full-vault recovery is not implemented; client-side entitlement checks are a soft commercial gate.

repositories.name: Apiary
repositories.focus: Offline iPhone beekeeping logbook with encrypted records and backups.
repositories.status: Functional offline-first iPhone release candidate with encrypted SQLite, exports, backups, and CI.
repositories.launchEvidence: Full offline-first iPhone implementation with encrypted SQLite, automated tests, backup checks, and iOS build validation.
repositories.next: Run physical-device and accessibility QA, then configure App Store signing and the purchase product.
repositories.concern: The local trial can reset after reinstall and must remain explicitly documented; release still needs owner legal approval.

repositories.name: App-Template
repositories.status: Reusable Flutter scaffold for local-only, local-first, and Supabase-backed products, with CI.
repositories.next: Complete a final baseline review, tag it, and enable GitHub template-repository mode.
repositories.concern: It is a scaffold rather than a launch product; provider-backed modes still require per-product security review.

repositories.name: Bivy
repositories.focus: Camping and RV trip log with site notes and recap exports.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the trip and campsite schema plus recap-export requirements, then scaffold from App-Template with product CI.
repositories.concern: No application implementation or product tests and build checks exist.

repositories.name: Chat-Armor
repositories.focus: Family-safety concept pending platform, consent, privacy, and legal feasibility review.
repositories.status: Research-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Resolve platform feasibility, consent, and the privacy model before scaffolding.
repositories.concern: The concept involves highly sensitive child and message data; beta-style claims must not imply an implemented product.

repositories.name: Convoy
repositories.focus: PCS and household move inventory with claim-ready exports.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the evidence and claim-export model, then scaffold from App-Template with product CI.
repositories.concern: No application implementation or product tests and build checks exist.

repositories.name: Cradle
repositories.focus: Feedings, diapers, sleep, growth, and milestone tracking.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the event model and caregiver-sharing boundary before scaffolding.
repositories.concern: The product would handle sensitive child data; sharing and recovery remain unresolved.

repositories.name: Deep-Six
repositories.focus: Scuba logbook with sites, buddies, and certification-ready records.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the dive and certification schema plus export requirements, then scaffold from App-Template with product CI.
repositories.concern: No application implementation or product tests and build checks exist.

repositories.name: Hook
repositories.focus: Fishing journal with private catches, photos, and encrypted spot records.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define encrypted photo and location storage plus recovery, then scaffold with CI.
repositories.concern: Sensitive location data and device-loss recovery behavior remain unresolved.

repositories.name: Majestic-Made-Hub
repositories.status: Implemented static Next.js portfolio and waitlist site pinned to Node 24, with web CI.
repositories.next: Keep product claims synchronized and complete owner and legal review before publishing.
repositories.concern: The site is not deployed; waitlist submissions add Supabase retention, deletion, and abuse-control obligations.

repositories.name: Paws
repositories.focus: Pet health records, medications, incidents, and vet-ready exports.
repositories.status: Functional encrypted local-vault Flutter release candidate with on-device PDF reports and CI.
repositories.launchEvidence: Functional encrypted local-vault implementation, automated tests, release configuration, PDF checks, and mobile release builds.
repositories.next: Resolve the trademark/name decision and run physical-device, accessibility, purchase, and store QA.
repositories.concern: Full-vault recovery is not implemented, and product copy must remain recordkeeping rather than veterinary advice.

repositories.name: Range
repositories.focus: Firearm registry, range log, ammo inventory, and license vault.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the MVP and security architecture before scaffolding.
repositories.concern: The proposed firearm and license data is particularly sensitive; no implementation or product validation exists.

repositories.name: ReachMe
repositories.focus: Local contact wallet, QR sharing, and optional expiring public links.
repositories.status: Functional Flutter app plus Cloudflare worker and web/PWA release candidate with CI.
repositories.launchEvidence: Functional local contact wallet, Cloudflare link service, web/PWA, automated tests, and CI validation.
repositories.next: Run provider-sandbox end-to-end tests plus hosted-link abuse, expiry, revoke, and recovery tests.
repositories.concern: Published fields are public, and the optional D1 link service creates recurring security, retention, and cost obligations.

repositories.name: RideBinder
repositories.focus: Motorcycle maintenance, documents, receipts, reminders, and resale history.
repositories.status: Functional local-first Flutter release candidate with optional cloud modules and CI.
repositories.launchEvidence: Substantial local-first implementation with automated tests, encrypted backup checks, and Android/iOS release builds.
repositories.next: Run physical-device backup, import, PDF, purchase, and store-signing QA with cloud flags off first.
repositories.concern: Optional sync, document storage, sharing, and AI extraction materially expand cost and security scope.

repositories.name: RoomProof
repositories.focus: Before/after cleaning reports with photos, checklists, issues, signatures, and PDFs.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define photo, signature, time, and location retention, then scaffold Flutter from App-Template with product CI.
repositories.concern: Evidence media and location metadata need an explicit privacy and deletion model before implementation.

repositories.name: RoutineCue
repositories.focus: Child routines, chores, approvals, points, rewards, and optional allowance tracking.
repositories.status: Functional Flutter and Supabase collaborative release candidate with mobile, backend, and local database checks.
repositories.launchEvidence: Substantial Flutter/Supabase implementation with automated mobile/backend tests, local database smoke checks, and mobile release builds.
repositories.next: Apply and test the reviewed backend in a non-production Supabase project, configure purchases/notifications, and run family-device QA.
repositories.concern: Child data and photo proof require high-trust cloud operations, strict retention, and continuing provider cost controls.

repositories.name: Steward
repositories.focus: Home inventory for insurance and household records.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Specify encryption, export, and recovery before scaffolding.
repositories.concern: Insurance and home data is sensitive; cloudless device-loss behavior remains unresolved.

repositories.name: Trove
repositories.focus: Collector registry for coins, stamps, cards, watches, and militaria.
repositories.status: Concept-only repository with implementation-readiness guardrails and automated governance validation on dev.
repositories.next: Define the schema plus import, export, and recovery, then scaffold from App-Template with product CI.
repositories.concern: No application implementation or product validation exists; portability and recovery are undefined.

repositories.name: Use-By
repositories.focus: Pantry, fridge, freezer, and counter expiration tracking.
repositories.status: Functional encrypted local-vault Flutter release candidate with CSV export and CI.
repositories.launchEvidence: Functional single-device encrypted inventory, automated tests, release configuration, export checks, and mobile release builds.
repositories.next: Complete date/time-zone, food-safety copy, recovery, physical-device, purchase, and store QA.
repositories.concern: Suggested dates are user-editable defaults, not food-safety advice; full-vault recovery is not implemented.

repositories.name: app-legal
repositories.status: Public legal and support site with draft coverage and automated structural validation for all seven release candidates.
repositories.next: Have both founders and qualified counsel review the pages against final binaries and store disclosures.
repositories.concern: Automated checks can verify completeness and consistency, but cannot establish legal adequacy.

repositories.name: wolfe-server-apps
repositories.status: Validated hardened Docker/Next.js deployment template; apps/ intentionally contains no deployable product.
repositories.next: Keep deferred until a server-backed product has an approved deployment need.
repositories.concern: This is infrastructure scaffolding, not a deployed service or launch product.

repositories.name: wolfe-server-infra
repositories.status: Substantial server hardening, deployment, monitoring, and backup-readiness automation with CI.
repositories.next: Configure scheduled off-site backups on the target host and complete a documented restore drill.
repositories.concern: Production readiness still depends on host-specific configuration, credentials, alert delivery, and a successful restore test.
